newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint little changed v dlr, dull forex futures mkt.
newsitem.headline: Forint little changed v dlr, dull forex futures mkt.

text.p: The Hungarian forint moved in a narrow range and closed a shade firmer against the dollar on Friday following dollar/mark changes on international markets, dealers said.

The forint closed at 174.55/59 to the U.S. unit, compared to 174.65/70 at the opening and 175.40/54 at midday, and traded some 25 to 30 pips weaker than the central bank's resistance level (bid), they said.
"Demand for the Pannon GSM bond is keeping the forint below the resistance level," said Szilvia Kucsera of Magyar Kulkereskedelmi Bank.

Hungarian mobile telephone company Pannon GSM auctioned on Thursday inflation-indexed bonds totalling 24 billion forints nominal value and received 30.5 billion forints worth of bids, the issue manager ING Barings said.
Kucsera added that forex demand would probably maintain the forint's 25/30 pip gap from the bid, up to the bonds' issue next Thursday.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange the yen accounted for more than half of low turnover of 2.04 billion forints.
The dollar and Swiss franc fell for most contracts while the yen rose. -- Budapest newsroom (36 1) 327 4040
